title: Seven-variable HEADER wire regression fast slice
scope: Add raw wire regression coverage for $FILLETRAD, $ELEVATION, $THICKNESS, $CHAMFERA, $CHAMFERB, $ANGBASE, and $ANGDIR under PAR-27/7L.4.
Separate absent source fields, explicit zero values, public parsed values, and canonical output presence.
Verify exact group code, value, uniqueness, output order, and following-record alignment before and after parseback.

method.limitations: The source and output are generated and read by this libdxfrw checkout. These controls verify local serialization and parser consistency only; they do not establish independent-producer conformance or native application acceptance.

implementation.behavior: Generated source DXFs are parsed into DRW_Header, then written and inspected with a code-aware raw HEADER scanner before secondary parseback. Present fields retain exact typed values; absent fields are confirmed absent in the parsed source model and emitted once with canonical zero defaults.
implementation.followingRecord: LINE endpoint values are checked in both source and output parseback.
